description: React component for rendering a list item representing a tag, with features like editing, drag-and-drop, context menu, and nested subtags.

classes.name: TagsListItem
classes.description: React functional component for displaying and managing a tag list item with nested subtags, drag-and-drop, and context menu features.

methods.name: toggleChildren
methods.description: Toggles the expanded/collapsed state of child tags.

methods.name: selectCurrentTag
methods.description: Sets the current tag as selected in the navigation controller.

methods.name: onBlur
methods.description: Saves the tag title when input loses focus.

methods.name: onInput
methods.description: Updates the tag title state on input change.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events, specifically Enter to blur input.

methods.name: onSubtagInput
methods.description: Updates subtag title state on input change.

methods.name: onSubtagInputBlur
methods.description: Creates a new subtag and resets input on blur.

methods.name: onSubtagKeyDown
methods.description: Handles Enter key to finalize subtag input.

methods.name: toggleContextMenu
methods.description: Opens or closes the context menu for the tag.

methods.name: onDragStart
methods.description: Initiates drag operation with tag UUID.

methods.name: onDragEnter
methods.description: Handles drag enter event, highlights drop target.

methods.name: onDragOver
methods.description: Handles drag over event, allows drop.

methods.name: onDrop
methods.description: Handles drop event, assigns parent tag if valid.
